title: Operations Guide
summary: Runbook for Nuvei connector health, status, monitoring, logs, and common operational failures.
notes: Manifest declares DOC. The document contains endpoint and operational constraint details, but its dominant purpose is runbook and operations guidance rather than a technical specification.
requirements: GET /health returns a simple unauthenticated liveness response.
GET /status requires JWT authentication and reports commercetools connectivity and Nuvei API reachability.
Load balancers and uptime monitoring should use GET /health.
API client scopes must include manage_payments, manage_orders, view_sessions, view_api_clients, manage_checkout_payment_intents, and introspect_oauth_tokens.
Connector deployments require all environment variables defined in connect.yaml.
constraints: NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM defaults to sha256 with 64 hex characters; legacy md5 uses 32 hex characters.
NUVEI_SECRET_KEY must match the key configured in the Nuvei dashboard.
NUVEI_API_BASE_URL must match the intended Nuvei environment, test or production.
Processor logs are structured JSON with level, message, correlationId, requestId, projectKey, and timestamp fields.
Secrets, PANs, and raw card data are not logged.
